purpose: Regression scenarios for evidence-first product design, progressive context routing, Figma design/code/library/motion/SwiftUI/FigJam workflows, live URL reconstruction, Code Connect, cross-tool design-system synchronization, component labs, reference research, fidelity, and graceful degradation.

scenarios.request: Add a compact filter control to an existing dashboard that already has tokens and shared form components.
must_do: reuse existing tokens/components
preserve the current app shell
render and verify the changed surface
must_not: replace the project stack
invent a parallel design system

scenarios.request: Rebuild this supplied product screenshot as a working responsive page.
must_do: preserve visible hierarchy and copy
keep controls code-native
compare the rendered result against the reference
must_not: reinterpret the design without approval
ship the screenshot as the UI

scenarios.request: Implement the supplied Figma frame inside the existing product.
must_do: extract design context when Figma tooling is available
reuse local product primitives where compatible
verify the rendered implementation
must_not: eyeball values when exact design data is available
claim exact extraction when Figma access is unavailable

scenarios.request: Create a visually distinctive new marketing experience with no supplied reference.
must_do: establish a coherent visual direction
cover the complete requested surface
use generated assets only when they materially help
must_not: stop at a hero section
fill the page with generic cards and fake metrics

scenarios.request: Build a production account-management screen with loading, empty, error, disabled, focus, and responsive states.
must_do: preserve repository conventions
implement material interaction states
verify desktop and smaller viewport behavior
must_not: hide prototype shortcuts as production quality
treat build success as visual completion

scenarios.request: Prototype a new editor interaction so the team can evaluate the idea quickly.
must_do: optimize for learning speed
keep the prototype coherent enough to evaluate
identify shortcuts that should not enter production
must_not: overengineer production infrastructure
pretend prototype debt is production-ready

scenarios.request: Implement a reference-led UI but the preferred design/browser tool is unavailable.
must_do: use the strongest available fallback
continue when optional tools are missing
state the exact verification limitation
must_not: claim an unavailable tool was used
block solely because an optional tool is missing

scenarios.request: A requested control is missing from the existing component library.
must_do: verify the gap first
extend the system at the narrowest reusable owner when justified
preserve semantic tokens and variants
must_not: fork library internals casually
scatter repeated one-off overrides

scenarios.request: Match a dense desktop reference and make it behave correctly on mobile.
must_do: audit density typography icons and container behavior
check at least one mobile-sized viewport
record unresolved fidelity gaps
must_not: declare pixel-perfect without direct comparison
ignore mobile line breaks and interaction states

scenarios.request: The UI is done but the feature now requires auth, data migration, and release work.
must_do: finish the active UI phase
return implementation evidence and deviations
hand broader engineering ownership to runtime-regression-debugger
must_not: expand this Skill into backend/release orchestration
ping-pong ownership repeatedly

scenarios.request: Implement a Figma design where the design system has Code Connect mappings to production components.
must_do: treat the accepted Figma frame as visual authority
reuse mapped production components
preserve mapped props/states and verify the rendered result
must_not: replace connected components with raw markup for convenience
use generic generated snippets as stronger authority than Code Connect

scenarios.request: Extend the product design system in Figma with a new reusable component family.
must_do: inspect variables libraries and existing component conventions first
define token bindings and component properties before scaling variants
validate the created design-system entities from evidence
must_not: create a parallel token taxonomy without proving a gap
build a large variant matrix when composition or instance swaps are more appropriate

scenarios.request: Research mature onboarding patterns before redesigning our onboarding flow.
must_do: research full flows rather than isolated screenshots
extract recurring interaction principles across several examples
adapt the principles to the target product system
must_not: treat a Mobbin result as authority unless the user selects it
copy another product's branding or proprietary copy

scenarios.request: Update an existing design-system component in a repository that already uses Storybook and visual regression tests.
must_do: inspect existing stories and component API before editing
cover material new states in stories/tests
run the repository visual regression path when available
must_not: recreate states already represented by the component library
declare success from typecheck alone

scenarios.request: Figma shows a new visual treatment, Storybook exposes fewer states, and the live product differs from both.
must_do: classify each source as authority evidence or inspiration
identify the exact conflict before implementing
preserve one explicit visual target and one component-state authority
must_not: average conflicting sources into a guessed design
silently choose whichever source is easiest

scenarios.request: Implement a design exported from Framer or Penpot when no native connector is available.
must_do: treat supplied exports/screenshots as the visual target
inspect repository components and tokens independently
state which structured design metadata could not be extracted
must_not: claim native design-tool inspection occurred
block solely because the native connector is unavailable

scenarios.request: Redesign an existing checkout flow whose current experience is available to inspect.
must_do: inspect the current flow before proposing the redesign
tie UX findings to observable steps or states
separate evidence from inference before ideation
must_not: redesign from memory without inspecting the available product
reduce the audit to aesthetic opinions

scenarios.request: We know onboarding is weak but do not know where users struggle most. Research the problem before designing.
must_do: collect evidence that can change the design
cluster recurring friction and distinguish severity frequency and confidence
turn research into a bounded product opportunity
must_not: treat one anecdote as representative
dump complaints without a design implication

scenarios.request: Explore three genuinely different directions for a new workspace home screen.
must_do: make the directions differ in hierarchy interaction or product framing
preserve hard product constraints in every direction
treat generated concepts as proposals until selected
must_not: present recolors of the same layout as distinct concepts
start production implementation before the active direction is resolved

scenarios.request: Compare a coded mobile screen against an accepted visual target before handoff.
must_do: normalize viewport state crop and density before judging
inspect typography spacing colors assets and copy explicitly
block clean handoff while actionable P0 P1 or P2 mismatches remain
must_not: file issues caused only by scale or browser chrome
pass QA from build success without visual comparison

scenarios.request: Our Figma variables, CSS token files, and Storybook component states have drifted apart. Reconcile them without creating another source of truth.
must_do: assign one authority per decision type
build a bounded drift map across tokens component API Figma states and Storybook states
update the canonical owner first and synchronize projections
must_not: edit every surface independently
call multiple conflicting surfaces the source of truth

scenarios.request: Add dark mode across an existing tokenized design system that is represented in Figma and code.
must_do: preserve semantic aliases across modes
avoid duplicating components when token modes can express the change
verify affected rendered states in both modes
must_not: scatter raw dark-mode colors through components
create a second unrelated token pipeline

scenarios.request: The production Button has a loading prop, Storybook has a loading story, but Figma has no loading state.
must_do: treat production component API as implemented behavior authority
identify the missing Figma state and mapping gap
update design representation and mapping without changing working code unnecessarily
must_not: remove the production state just to match Figma
hide the drift in documentation

scenarios.request: Implement the motion defined on this Figma component in the existing production UI without rebuilding the screen.
must_do: route to the dedicated Figma motion implementation workflow when available
preserve the existing component structure and merge motion into it
verify interaction motion performance and reduced-motion behavior
must_not: rebuild unrelated UI just to add animation
translate Figma or CSS easing into an unsupported framework API by guesswork

scenarios.request: Keep an iOS SwiftUI screen and its Figma design aligned in both directions.
must_do: route to the dedicated SwiftUI Figma workflow when available
preserve semantic iOS colors symbols and system patterns
treat the screenshot as visual truth while mapping to native SwiftUI structure
must_not: transliterate web layout primitives directly into SwiftUI
replace SF Symbol semantics with guessed glyph codepoints

scenarios.request: Map the real onboarding journey as an editable FigJam flow before redesigning it.
must_do: ground the diagram in the inspected product flow
use the dedicated FigJam diagram workflow when supported
keep product evidence separate from visual annotations
must_not: invent missing steps to make the diagram look complete
use a diagram as a substitute for inspecting the actual flow

scenarios.request: Push an existing production screen into Figma while preserving our component and token system.
must_do: inspect production components tokens and Code Connect before writing
route to the dedicated Figma page-generation workflow when available
reuse existing Figma variables and library components instead of recreating them
must_not: create a parallel Figma design system
hardcode repeated values that already exist as variables

scenarios.request: Create or update Figma Code Connect mappings for our published design-system components.
must_do: route to the dedicated Code Connect authoring workflow when available
map real Figma properties to real production component props
validate nested and variant mappings against the production API
must_not: invent code props to match Figma properties
replace an existing parser-based mapping blindly when a parallel supported mapping format is required

scenarios.request: Faithfully recreate our own live marketing page as a local frontend, including responsive behavior and interactions.
must_do: capture desktop mobile DOM assets and material interactions before coding
build only from captured evidence within scope
compare the rendered implementation against the live source at matching states
must_not: hotlink source assets in the final app
treat build or server health as visual verification

scenarios.request: Redesign our product page to be better, using this live URL as context.
must_do: treat the live page as current-state evidence rather than automatic clone authority
audit the relevant existing experience before redesigning
lock a new accepted design target before fidelity implementation
must_not: recreate the source pixel-for-pixel without being asked
mix clone constraints with redesign freedom implicitly
